en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small town nestled among rolling hills and fields, framed by tree branches in the foreground. The settlement has many low houses and a few larger buildings, including what appears to be a church tower near the center. In the grassy foreground, white caption text is printed directly on the image reading "SABILE – KURZEMES ŠVEICE." with a small number "12.8." at the lower right.
